scope: Opt-in reader-origin TABLE entity CRC/frame/class/ledger source evidence, jointly sealed with the existing source-bound extension dictionary, root and nine children. No typed TABLE model binding or output authority.
implementation: At OBJECTS entry, after successful BLOCKS, the private selected handle is looked up in the HANDLE-map ledger and must be Published exactly once with a decoded-buffer source tuple. Size is preflighted to 64 KiB and shares the 2 MiB candidate budget before frame allocation. DwgObjectFrame rereads and verifies frame CRC.

The encoded type is resolved through the reader-owned class map; entity route and exact ACAD_TABLE/AcDbTable names and encoded/resolved identity are required. Candidate staging refuses duplicate kind/handle/ordinal/location. Delivery requires successful whole operation, finalized complete coverage, no transition violation and zero entity/object parse failures.

The immutable ticket body is inspected against the bounded AC1018 common selector profile: proxy flag and 2104-byte bounded opaque proxy, entmode 2, zero reactors, present xdictionary, and unaligned H3 target. Following layer/block/style H5 tokens are observed, not resolved or semantically qualified.

The strict bundle additionally checks that the H3 target is the reader-bound dictionary and its owner target is the authenticated entity handle. The editable TABLE callback/model is deliberately not retained or compared; spoofing its xdictionary does not change source evidence. Generic AC1018 common-link evidence remains Unknown.

physical_source.result: PASS same-import 0x9c TABLE H3 to DICTIONARY 0xbb, DICTIONARY H4 owner to 0x9c, code-2 entry to root 0xbc, three custom candidates and nine selected child XRECORDs. Known unrelated HEADER integrity observation remains.
controls: A thrown actual TABLE callback during BLOCKS replay makes import fail and exposes no bundle; the same adapter succeeds on retry.
Changed live TABLE callback sets its retained xdictionary to zero while immutable source evidence remains valid, explicitly demonstrating no typed-model binding.
Same- and cross-adapter same-data reentry, missing TABLE selection, XRECORD mutation and selected-entity ticket allocation fault each fail closed and permit retry.
Strict DXF output refuses and preserves sentinel; ordinary opt-out read keeps generic AC1018 common-link evidence Unknown.

automated_generated_tests.observer: Locally synthesized unaligned TABLE-like body with 2104 scratch proxy bytes, tested across every truncation, H3 role and target, missing flag, reactors, reserved selector, declared proxy zero/overflow, handle/class mismatch, byte quota, and all observed observer allocation failures with retry. The body is not a complete parseable TABLE.
automated_generated_tests.reader_lease: In a separate runnable CTest, a locally framed body with freshly generated CRC and a test-only private ledger/class map drives the actual post-BLOCKS OBJECTS staging and delivery functions. Controls cover Published-once vs staged/duplicate publication, source offset space/identity/ordinal, class entity route, record/class names and resolved number, missing class/selection, bad CRC, opt-out, source size and shared byte quotas, duplicate stage, one staged-allocation failure, incomplete coverage, entity/object parse failure, integrity violation, and valid private ticket. This is an isolated reader harness, not a generated whole-DWG graph.
automated_generated_tests.prior: Existing generated dictionary/root/child bundle compatibility, source mutation, CRC and retry test passes in the same cohort.

limitations: No generated whole-DWG positive for the populated TABLE graph: the production writer correctly refuses it. Automated tests instead isolate the generated observer and real reader lease; full integration evidence uses the scratch physical source.
Source evidence does not freeze or validate an editable TABLE model; it cannot be used as permission for output.
Proxy bytes and remaining TABLE payload are opaque. Synthesized carrier metadata is not evidence of absent data-storage, ACIS or ACDS.
TABLESTYLE/resource and wider graph closure, codepage interpretation, independent semantic interoperability and atomic populated-graph output remain open.
One reader-stage allocation and one adapter-ticket allocation failure are sampled; end-to-end allocation coverage is not exhaustive.
